# Project Readiness Brief: ALPHA-ACCEPTANCE-71

The materials report a passing integration test suite for ALPHA-ACCEPTANCE-71 with a 2026-12-03 delivery target, but deployment approval is outstanding and no budget has been provided. Readiness and delivery risk cannot be fully assessed because the source does not define readiness criteria or provide approval, budget, coverage or deployment details.

## Findings

Status: The integration test suite passed on November 24, 2026. The delivery target is 2026-12-03. The release owner has not approved the deployment. The budget has not been provided. The material identifies itself as synthetic acceptance material, not customer data.

Delivery risk: Readiness and schedule risk cannot be quantified from the source. Deployment approval is outstanding. Budget status is unspecified. The material does not state that approval or budget is a precondition for delivery, nor does it provide an approval date, rationale, budget figures, or risk rating. The source provides no basis to conclude the target will or will not be met.

Missing information: release owner approval decision, rationale and expected date; budget amount, approval status and spend; test coverage, defect counts and acceptance criteria; deployment plan, environment readiness and rollback provisions; stakeholders and dependencies; definition of readiness or go/no-go criteria.

## Limitations

The review relies only on the supplied synthetic acceptance material. No tools, files, or external sources were used, and the test result, schedule, approval state and budget state were not independently verified. The source does not define readiness, state whether approval or budget is required before delivery, or give any risk rating. Statements about risk are therefore assessments of what cannot be determined, not forecasts.

## Source quotations

> Project ALPHA-ACCEPTANCE-71.

> The integration test suite passed on November 24, 2026.

> Delivery target: 2026-12-03.

> The release owner has not approved the deployment.

> The budget has not been provided.

> This is synthetic acceptance material, not customer data.

---

# Project BETA-ACCEPTANCE-92 readiness brief

Integration testing passed on November 24, 2026, and the delivery target is December 17, 2026. However, release owner approval is outstanding and budget information has not been provided. On the supplied material, readiness cannot be confirmed, and delivery risk centers on the missing approval and absent budget detail.

## Findings

Status: the integration test suite passed on November 24, 2026, and the stated delivery target is 2026-12-17. The release owner has not approved the deployment. Delivery risk: approval remains outstanding, and no approval date, criteria, or conditions are recorded. Budget readiness cannot be assessed because no budget was provided. Missing information includes release owner approval status and expected date, approval criteria or conditions, budget amount and funding state, acceptance scope beyond the integration suite, other test layers, and formal stakeholder or customer sign-off. The material is described as synthetic acceptance material, not customer data, which limits how far the test result can be generalized.

## Limitations

Only one self-described synthetic material set was available, and none of its statements were independently verified. The material does not establish that release owner approval is a mandatory deployment gate, does not quantify schedule or cost risk, and does not describe scope, other test layers, or sign-off. Absent information is treated as unknown rather than as proof of failure.

## Source quotations

> Project BETA-ACCEPTANCE-92.

> The integration test suite passed on November 24, 2026.

> Delivery target: 2026-12-17.

> The release owner has not approved the deployment.

> The budget has not been provided.

> This is synthetic acceptance material, not customer data.

---
